capabilities: Auto-format spacing and punctuation between Chinese, English and digits while typing
Enhance editing with smart backspace, tabout, smart paste and progressive selection
Create custom input, delete and select-key transformation rules with regex and tabstops
Run commands to format the article or selection, delete blank lines and toggle auto-format
Exclude files by path pattern and apply IME compatibility fixes
intentEvidence: Easy Typing is an enhancement plugin for Obsidian that improves the writing experience through automatic text formatting
problem: Obsidian has no built-in automatic text formatting while typing, especially for mixed Chinese/English spacing and full-width punctuation, and editing inside lists, quotes and code is repetitive.
summary: Typing enhancement plugin that auto-formats CJK/English spacing and punctuation, adds smart editing helpers, and runs custom regex transformation rules as you type.
